# Problems

The problem sets for the course are collected here. Each problem set is split into parts, and each part is a self-contained notebook that you can download and run.

- **Problem Set 1** covers linear models and validation (Part 1), unsupervised linear models (Part 2), and bilinear models with stochastic gradient descent (Part 3).
- **Problem Set 2** covers automatic differentiation (Part 1) and improving GANs for airfoil generation (Part 2).
